annotations.title: Inspect a paid endpoint before paying

description: Inspect any pay-per-call (HTTP 402) endpoint before you pay: decodes its payment terms (version, network, asset, price in dollars, payee), checks the listing metadata, lists problems that make agents fail, and gives a safety verdict: trap-level prices, payment in an unrecognised token, a payee on the sanctions list, or a domain registered in the last 30 days. Plus the seller's track record on the Base network: payments and distinct payer wallets to the payee in the last ~5.5 hours, and our longer samples where we have them. US$0.005 per call; 3 free calls a day.
